name: Contrôleur de température
description: Very tall slender adult, mottled charcoal-olive skin, high elongated cranium and narrow orbital folds, long thin but biological tendril locks, four clearly separate mandibular lobes. High-collar soot-black tunic, long narrow leather apron, bronze elbow guards. Holds a compact optical furnace pyrometer with small amber glass viewing port at chest, other hand rests near belt tool pouch. Accurate small scientific instrument, not gun.
prompt:

Match its actual species anatomy rigorously, including the cranial dome, alien orbital brow folds, reptilian granular skin, no human nose bridge or human lips, and exactly FOUR distinct EXTERNAL fleshy mandibles framing a separate INNER toothed mouth. Two upper cheek mandible lobes each carry one short inward/downward tusk; two larger lower mandible lobes each carry one long upward-curving tusk. For exposed faces, the four fleshy lobes must be individually legible, slightly open in calm neutral expression. If a complete work mask is expressly specified in the individual design, keep that mask instead, correctly fitted over Yautja anatomy; the facial constraints apply to visible skin only. Not two tubes under the nose, not merely two hanging fangs, not an orc/human jaw. Thick scalp tendrils are biological dreadlocks, never human hair. Keep body three-quarter RIGHT but turn exposed FACE three-quarter TOWARD VIEWER enough to clearly show all4 mandibles. Do not copy the photo's human clothing, scene, logos or watermark. Variants can change brow proportions, spots, scars and tendrils, but NEVER simplify this anatomy.
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce exactly ONE distinct full-body adult Yautja SMELTER NPC of the Forges de la Caldeira volcanic tribe. Image2 is clothing and tribe-material reference: soot-dark basalt steel, worn copper-bronze thermal armor plates, black protective underlayers, tough dark brown leather smelting aprons, reinforced work gloves, tiny controlled amber status vents, practical foundry tongs and instruments. Image3 is cinematic realistic handpainted 2D game art and slightly elevated camera/style reference. Same tribe role but completely new individual in each image, new body proportions, cranium/tendrils or unique fitted Yautja work biomask, garment tailoring, apron and tools. Worker at calm idle between jobs, not fighting. Exposed-face variants are away from active furnace, so any held metal is cool and safe; no flames, smoke, molten stream or sparks. All held tools, feet and full dreadlocks inside frame with at least8% empty transparent margins on every side. Small practical tools rather than weapons; every prop physically held or strapped. Three-quarter body facing RIGHT, exposed face turned slightly toward viewer so all four mandibles readable. Gentle consistent overhead-left lighting, crisp silhouette, detailed leather/metal/fabric. ACTUAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background. No scene, floor, shadows on ground, lava puddle, platform, scenery, second character, animals, text, numerals, symbols like letters, watermark, frame, atlas or collage. Neither character nor tools cropped.
